official.credit: approximately top 55% of year and region
official.distinction: approximately top 20% of year and region
official.high_distinction: approximately top 3% of year and region
official.prize: generally no more than 1 in 300 within region and year group
official.note: Official raw-score cutoffs vary by year and region. The app must use paper-year WA cutoffs when verified; otherwise label the result as an estimate.

practice_estimate_wa.label: WA practice reference — based on published 2025 WA cutoffs, not a guarantee for another paper/year
practice_estimate_wa.rationale: AMT cutoffs vary by year level, paper difficulty and region. For an authored practice paper with no official cutoff, Summit One uses the published 2025 WA table only as a clearly labelled reference. A verified paper-year WA cutoff overrides it.

2025.source: 3E Learning WA published cutoff image (third-party public copy; final award authority remains AMT)
